about: CP-44 G06 dev cases (mind-written, for the post-set-5 global-scope change): wording that means every world makes a rule or taste global; wording tied to one world keeps it there. Format: live_cp44_dev.py scenarios.

steps.say: No matter which world we're in, never place beds in the Nether.

current.subject: beds in the Nether
current.object: never place beds in the Nether

steps.say: Whatever map we play on, don't trade with wandering traders.
On every server, keep the hotbar's first slot for a sword.

current.subject: hotbar first slot
current.object: keep the first hotbar slot for a sword

steps.say: In all my worlds, never use lava buckets near wood.

current.subject: lava buckets
current.object: never use lava buckets near wood

steps.say: Across worlds, I prefer copper lanterns for lighting.
On this map, never break the stone bridge.
Here, don't harvest the pumpkins by the gate.

absent.subject: pumpkins by the gate
absent.object: don't harvest the pumpkins by the gate

steps.say: In this world, leave the llamas alone.
